# io.systemd.Report

<!-- Generated by `make docs-reference`. Do not edit. -->

Frontend API for generating system reports. This interface is implemented by systemd-report, which aggregates the metrics exposed by the io.systemd.Metrics services linked into /run/systemd/report/.

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Go package | [`github.com/rossedman/sdvarlink/systemd/latest/report`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/rossedman/sdvarlink/systemd/latest/report) |
| Available since | systemd v262 |
| Methods · types · errors | 2 · 1 · 0 |

## Methods

### Generate

Generate a report and return it as a JSON object.

```go
func (c *Client) Generate(ctx context.Context, in GenerateIn) (*GenerateOut, error)
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `matches` | `?[]string` | Selects which metrics to include in the report, as an array of metric family names or prefixes thereof. If unset or empty all available metrics are included. This matches the [MATCH…] arguments of the systemd-report command line tool. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report` | `object` | The generated report as a JSON object. This mode does not sign the report, hence a precise binary formatting of the JSON data is not relevant. |

### GenerateSigned

Generate a signed report and return it Base64 encoded.

```go
func (c *Client) GenerateSigned(ctx context.Context, in GenerateSignedIn) (*GenerateSignedOut, error)
```

**Parameters**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `matches` | `?[]string` | Selects which metrics to include in the report, as an array of metric family names or prefixes thereof. If unset or empty all available metrics are included. This matches the [MATCH…] arguments of the systemd-report command line tool. |
| `mode` | `?SignMode` | How to handle multiple signers. Defaults to requireOne if unset. |

**Reply**

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reportData` | `string` | The generated, signed report in Base64. A precise binary formatting of the JSON data is important to authenticate the signature. This data contains a JSON-SEQ compliant stream of objects, the first being the report, the following ones signature objects. |

## Types

### SignMode

Policy for how multiple signers are aggregated.

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bestEffort` | Emit whatever signatures are available, never fail on signing. |
| `requireOne` | Require at least one signature; tolerate individual signer failures. (Default.) |
| `requireAll` | Require every signing mechanism to succeed with a signature. |
